investment_recommendation:
### Provisional Buy
The strong fiscal 2026 GAAP diluted EPS of $20.76 is the key supported figure driving this provisional Buy recommendation, indicative of solid profitability and shareholder earnings power [EX-99.1 line 52].

Insight: Costco's material revenue concentration in California, representing 26% of U.S. net sales in 2026, indicates notable geographic risk exposure that should be monitored alongside growth strategies [10-K line L000837].
